channel.title: IN-SKY.EU updates
channel.description: mc.in-sky.eu: a vanilla-style OneBlock server where every island is its own private world.

item.title: Update 1.1.3.0: island ranks, trusted players and permissions
item.description: Give friends a rank, trust players to build without joining your team, and choose which rank can do what on your island. Plus more ores and diamonds in several phases.

item.title: Update 1.1.1: sidebar scoreboard
item.description: A new sidebar shows your phase, blocks mined, blocks until the next phase, island level and border tier.

item.title: Update 1.1: Minecraft 26.3, new phases and safer islands
item.description: Support for Minecraft Java 26.3, a new set of 21 phases that loops at 16,000 blocks, better island protection, a safer /is reset, and many fixes to invites and teams.
